title: FPV Front: Daybreak
summary: Ukrainian FPV drone military arcade. Original fictionalized scenes show invading Russian military machinery without portrait likenesses or documentary claims.

theme.title: FPV Front: Daybreak
theme.artDirection: Crisp 16-bit graphite machinery, golden fields, blue accents. Pixel silhouettes carry threats; illustration contains static scenery, never collision truth. Player art uses a practical FPV carbon frame, separate propeller blades, compact battery and front camera, with restrained Ukrainian blue/yellow accents. Current artwork uses no Z markings anywhere. Ukrainian, hostile military and neutral subjects stay explicitly distinct.
theme.cultureNotes: Contemporary Ukrainian identity; ornament reserved for safe borders. Geographic layouts and tactical systems are fictional arcade abstractions.

assets.brief: Original Ukrainian FPV quadcopter: thin carbon X-frame, four separate motors/propeller blades, strapped battery, small front camera and short antenna. Restrained blue/yellow accent and thin ivory outline. Proposed 32 px frame; inspect actual-size readability before export. No Z markings or hostile insignia. Four planned consistent frames, not delivered assets.
